text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC."}],"comment":"The heat treatment is specified but the stage at which it applies (before or after machining, before or after plating) is not stated. Without this sequence the shop cannot plan operations correctly and risks cracking the zinc coating or machining hardened stock. The designer should add a note specifying when toughening occurs relative to machining and surface treatment.","recommended_correction":"Add wording such as 'HEAT TREAT BEFORE MACHINING' or 'HEAT TREAT AFTER MACHINING, BEFORE PLATING' to the heat treatment callout."},{"rule_id":"TL-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D11","page":1,"quote":"30"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D12","page":1,"quote":"20"}],"comment":"Dimensions D11 and D12 define the bore that feature F1 describes as an 'M8 thread', yet neither carries a thread designation or tolerance class. A mating fastener cannot be reliably selected or inspected without a thread fit callout. The designer should replace or supplement these diameters with a proper thread callout including its tolerance class (e.g., M8 x 1.25 – 6H).","recommended_correction":"Call out the M8 thread with its pitch and tolerance class on the drawing instead of bare diameters."}]}
